items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: I came back in the field and played several... did some funeral work with Peter Bocca and them.

ctx.x: Harold Dejean was in one of those bands.

Harold Dejean was in our same unit. Harold Dejean. Gilbert Jung, Henry Russ. That's all the fellas from this. That's the two men that we all joined together, was Henry Russ and Gilbert Jung. We all joined the Navy, the Navy band the same day. And from that time on, well, we just got out of the Navy. I'm trying to think now.
